# NEW 2026-11-22 v12.5 Worker 1: Espionage, Court Intrigue, Dynastic Diplomacy 2.0 & 6 Universal Cabinet Actions (oe_dip2_, 0 slots, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v125_diplomacy.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# 1. Intercept & Decipher War Dispatches (截获密信与破译军情)
oe_dip2_intercept_war_cipher = {
	type = diplomacy
	category = CATEGORY_COVERT_ACTIONS
	block_when_at_war = no
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 12
	use_in_automation = no

	ai_prerequisite = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		gold >= 60
	}

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			num_locations > 0
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			gold >= 50
		}
	}

	cooldown = {
		type = oe_dip2_intercept_cipher_cd
		years = 5
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_country"
		default_sort = will
		column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_covert }
		visible = {
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			country_exists = this
			is_rebel_country = no
			scope:actor = { has_discovered = prev.capital }
		}
		enabled = {
			scope:actor = {
				spy_network = { target = prev value >= 35 }
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
			scope:recipient = {
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_dip2_cipher_compromised years = 2 mode = replace }
				save_scope_as = oe_dip2_cipher_target
			}
			scope:actor = {
				add_spy_network = { target = scope:recipient value = -35 }
				change_gold_effect_bounded = { scale = -1.5 min = 50 max = 350 }
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_dip2_cipher_advantage years = 3 mode = replace }
				oe_dip2_bump_ops_count = yes
				if = {
					limit = { is_at_war_with = scope:recipient }
					random_list = {
						30 = { trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_dip2.1 days = 5 } }
						40 = { trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_dip2.2 days = 10 } }
						30 = { }
					}
				}
				else = {
					random_list = {
						30 = { trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_dip2.1 days = 5 } }
						70 = { }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_dip2_intercept_war_cipher_tt
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = -50
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:recipient
				scope:actor = {
					spy_network = { target = scope:recipient value >= 45 }
					OR = {
						is_at_war_with = scope:recipient
						AND = {
							is_rival_of = scope:recipient
							opinion = { target = scope:recipient value < -25 }
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = 85
		}
	}
}

# 2. Fund Exiled Claimant (资助敌国流亡宣称者)
oe_dip2_fund_exile_claimant = {
	type = diplomacy
	category = CATEGORY_COVERT_ACTIONS
	block_when_at_war = no
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 24
	use_in_automation = no

	ai_prerequisite = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		is_subject = no
		gold >= 300
	}

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_subject = no
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			gold >= 150
		}
	}

	cooldown = {
		type = oe_dip2_fund_claimant_cd
		years = 10
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_country"
		default_sort = will
		column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_covert }
		visible = {
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			country_exists = this
			is_rebel_country = no
			oe_dip2_is_monarchy_or_empire = yes
			scope:actor = { has_discovered = prev.capital }
		}
		enabled = {
			scope:actor = {
				spy_network = { target = prev value >= 45 }
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
			scope:actor = {
				add_spy_network = { target = scope:recipient value = -45 }
				change_gold_effect_bounded = { scale = -4.0 min = 120 max = 1200 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_dip2_harboring_claimant value = scope:recipient years = 10 }
				oe_dip2_bump_ops_count = yes
				save_scope_as = oe_dip2_instigator
			}
			scope:recipient = {
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_dip2_exile_pretender_shadow years = 5 mode = replace }
				add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_dip2_b_funded_pretender }
				save_scope_as = oe_dip2_claimant_victim
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_dip2.3 days = 5 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:recipient = {
						OR = {
							stability < 15
							legitimacy < 60
						}
					}
				}
				scope:actor = {
					trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_dip2.4 days = 30 }
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_dip2_fund_exile_claimant_tt
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = -60
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:recipient
				scope:actor = {
					is_rival_of = scope:recipient
					gold >= 300
				}
				scope:recipient = {
					stability < 20
				}
			}
			add = 90
		}
	}
}

# 3. Royal Hostage Exchange & Truce Surety (皇室质子交换与停战担保)
oe_dip2_royal_hostage_exchange = {
	type = diplomacy
	category = CATEGORY_INFLUENCE_ACTIONS
	block_when_at_war = yes
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36
	use_in_automation = no

	ai_prerequisite = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		is_subject = no
		at_war = no
		government_type = government_type:monarchy
	}

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_subject = no
			government_type = government_type:monarchy
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			at_war = no
		}
	}

	cooldown = {
		type = oe_dip2_hostage_exchange_cd
		years = 15
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_country"
		default_sort = will
		column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_with_next_stage_characters }
		visible = {
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			country_exists = this
			is_rebel_country = no
			government_type = government_type:monarchy
			NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:actor }
			OR = {
				is_subject_of = scope:actor
				is_subject = no
			}
			scope:actor = { has_discovered = prev.capital }
		}
		enabled = {
			at_war = no
			num_characters > 1
			OR = {
				is_subject_of = scope:actor
				scope:actor = { favors = { target = prev value >= 15 } }
			}
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = character
		source = recipient
		target_flag = target
		name = "oe_dip2_hostage_select_character"
		none_available_msg_key = "oe_dip2_hostage_no_characters"
		column = { data = character_info }
		visible = {
			oe_dip2_eligible_hostage_character = yes
			OR = {
				is_heir = no
				scope:recipient = { is_subject_of = scope:actor }
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:recipient exists = scope:target }
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { is_subject_of = scope:actor } }
				scope:recipient = {
					add_liberty_desire = -20
				}
			}
			else = {
				scope:actor = {
					add_favors = { target = scope:recipient value = -15 }
					add_truce_with = { target = scope:recipient years = 5 mutual = yes }
				}
			}
			scope:target = {
				move_country = scope:actor
				add_character_modifier = { modifier = oe_dip2_royal_hostage_char years = 10 mode = replace }
				set_variable = { name = oe_dip2_hostage_home value = scope:recipient }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_dip2_hostage_surety_mod years = 10 mode = replace }
				oe_dip2_bump_ops_count = yes
			}
			scope:recipient = {
				add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_dip2_b_hostage_surety }
			}
		}
		else = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_dip2_royal_hostage_exchange_tt
		}
	}

	diplo_chance = {
		base = -10
		opinion = 0.5
		diplomatic_reputation = 5
		relative_strength = 40
		overlord = 60
		same_religion = 10
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = -20
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:recipient
				scope:recipient = {
					is_subject_of = scope:actor
					liberty_desire >= 40
				}
			}
			add = 60
		}
	}
}

# 4. Poach Foreign Master or General (高薪挖角名将与宫廷大师)
oe_dip2_poach_foreign_master = {
	type = diplomacy
	category = CATEGORY_COVERT_ACTIONS
	block_when_at_war = yes
	ai_tick = never
	use_in_automation = no

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_subject = no
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			gold >= 200
			prestige >= 10
		}
	}

	cooldown = {
		type = oe_dip2_poach_master_cd
		years = 10
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_country"
		default_sort = will
		column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_covert }
		visible = {
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			country_exists = this
			is_rebel_country = no
			scope:actor = { has_discovered = prev.capital }
		}
		enabled = {
			scope:actor = {
				spy_network = { target = prev value >= 40 }
			}
			num_characters > 1
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = character
		source = recipient
		target_flag = target
		name = "oe_dip2_poach_select_character"
		none_available_msg_key = "oe_dip2_poach_no_characters"
		column = { data = character_info }
		visible = {
			oe_dip2_eligible_poach_character = yes
		}
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:recipient exists = scope:target }
			scope:actor = {
				add_spy_network = { target = scope:recipient value = -40 }
				change_gold_effect_bounded = { scale = -5.0 min = 180 max = 1500 }
				oe_dip2_apply_poach_bonus = yes
				oe_dip2_bump_ops_count = yes
				save_scope_as = oe_dip2_poacher
			}
			scope:target = {
				move_country = scope:actor
				add_character_modifier = { modifier = oe_dip2_poached_master_char years = 5 mode = replace }
				save_scope_as = oe_dip2_poached_master
			}
			scope:recipient = {
				add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_dip2_b_poached_talent }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_dip2.5 days = 5 }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_dip2.6 days = 30 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_dip2_poach_foreign_master_tt
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = { value = -100 }
}

# 5. Contest Dynastic Succession (干预跨国联姻继承危机)
oe_dip2_contest_dynastic_succession = {
	type = diplomacy
	category = CATEGORY_INFLUENCE_ACTIONS
	block_when_at_war = yes
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36
	use_in_automation = no

	ai_prerequisite = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		is_subject = no
		at_war = no
		government_type = government_type:monarchy
		prestige >= 25
	}

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_subject = no
			government_type = government_type:monarchy
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			at_war = no
			prestige >= 25
		}
	}

	cooldown = {
		type = oe_dip2_contest_succession_cd
		years = 15
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_country"
		default_sort = will
		column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_dynastic }
		visible = {
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			country_exists = this
			is_rebel_country = no
			government_type = government_type:monarchy
			religion.group = scope:actor.religion.group
			scope:actor = { has_discovered = prev.capital }
		}
		enabled = {
			oe_dip2_has_succession_opening = yes
			NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:actor }
			OR = {
				scope:actor = { favors = { target = prev value >= 20 } }
				scope:actor = { spy_network = { target = prev value >= 40 } }
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { favors = { target = scope:recipient value >= 20 } }
					add_favors = { target = scope:recipient value = -20 }
				}
				else = {
					add_spy_network = { target = scope:recipient value = -40 }
				}
				add_prestige = -15
				oe_dip2_bump_ops_count = yes
				save_scope_as = oe_dip2_claimant_power
			}
			scope:recipient = {
				add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_dip2_b_dynastic_meddling }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_dip2.7 days = 3 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_dip2_contest_dynastic_succession_tt
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = -40
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:recipient
				scope:actor = {
					total_population > scope:recipient.total_population
					NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = scope:recipient } }
				}
			}
			add = 65
		}
	}
}
